entities.summary: Louis Schmeisser was one of the best-known weapon technical designers of Europe. He is associated with the early development and production of the series of guns that would become the Bergmann machine guns used during the First World War. He designed the Dreyse 1907 Pistol which was used in both World Wars. Louis Schmeisser was a scientists & inventors from Zöllnitz (1848-02-05, Zöllnitz–1917-03-23). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
